title: 蒙布朗隧道~Mont Blanc Tunnel
focus: 火災系統邊界、既有襯砌與跨境協作~Fire-system boundaries, existing lining and cross-border coordination
summary: 蒙布朗隧道連接法國與義大利，營運機構列長11.6公里並記錄1965年開通。本課以長公路的系統思考為主軸，分別研究通風網路、受熱材料、事故偵知、人的反應、設備冗餘及整修交付。歷史事件只用核對過的年代，假想事故條件不被包裝為原事故重建。~Mont Blanc Tunnel connects France and Italy; its operator reports 11.6 km and opening in 1965. This course uses a systems perspective on ventilation networks, heated materials, detection, human response, redundancy and refurbishment handover. Historical dates follow checked records, while hypothetical incident conditions are not presented as reconstruction of an actual accident.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 蒙布朗跨境服務涉及兩端引道和管制，教材比較相同端點的洞內時間及整體等待而非單一最短車程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Cross-border service includes approaches and controls; compare in-tunnel time and total waiting between common endpoints rather than one shortest journey. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=17.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=17.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.92 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=17.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.92 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 隧道內暢通不代表兩端交通系統沒有瓶頸。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Free flow inside does not establish unconstrained approaches. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 蒙布朗案例用來研究正常污染稀釋與假想火災控煙的不同目標，不能只提高風量就宣稱情境改善。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Distinguish normal pollutant dilution from hypothetical fire smoke-control objectives; more airflow alone does not prove an improved scenario. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.4775 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.4775 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 錯誤風向可能把煙帶向人員區，即使總風量增加。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Wrong airflow direction can carry smoke toward users despite increased total flow. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 拘束溫度應變~Restrained thermal strain
units.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫~Thermal restraint and component cracking
units.mechanism: 假想受熱襯砌的熱膨脹拘束與混凝土剝落屬不同機制，蒙布朗教材只以線彈性式建立量級。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。~Restrained expansion and concrete spalling are different mechanisms; a linear-elastic exercise establishes scale without predicting actual fire damage. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
units.model: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=23 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.75 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.325 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=23 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.75 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.325 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 均溫模型不能代表表層急熱梯度及剝落。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。~Uniform temperature cannot represent rapid surface gradients or spalling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.
units.misconception: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。~Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
units.practice: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 長期整修需區分原有缺陷與新病害，蒙布朗襯砌教學以幾何、材料和支承證據重建荷載路徑。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Refurbishment separates legacy defects from new deterioration using geometry, material and support evidence to reconstruct load paths. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.56 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=5.28 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.808 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.56 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.28 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.808 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照歷年裂縫圖、掃描斷面及滲水位置。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare historical crack maps, scanned sections and leak locations. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把所有新看見的裂縫當新產生會錯估劣化速率。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~Treating newly observed cracks as newly formed overstates deterioration rate. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：對照歷年裂縫圖、掃描斷面及滲水位置。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare historical crack maps, scanned sections and leak locations. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度~Visual adaptation and pavement luminance
units.mechanism: 事故和正常行車需要不同的視覺資訊，教材把路面照明與方向標示的可見性分開。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。~Normal driving and incident response need different visual information; distinguish road lighting from visibility of directional signs. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：照度=106 lx；反射率=0.24 無因次。L=ρE/π=8.0978 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.90758 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=106 lx; reflectance=0.24 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=8.0978 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.90758 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從停車人員和駕駛兩種視角核對標示及亮度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check signs and luminance from stopped-user and driving viewpoints. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 行車視角合格不保證下車後能辨識安全路徑。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。~Adequate driving visibility does not prove that a user on foot can identify the safe route. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.
units.misconception: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。~Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
units.practice: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從停車人員和駕駛兩種視角核對標示及亮度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Check signs and luminance from stopped-user and driving viewpoints. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 蒙布朗假想情境將偵知、決策、下車和步行分段，避免只以出口距離估算完整撤離。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Separate detection, decision, vehicle exit and walking in a hypothetical Mont Blanc scenario rather than estimating total evacuation from distance alone. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=106 s；行走距離=300 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=481 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為518.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=106 s; travel distance=300 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=481 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 518.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 演練按時間戳辨認各階段，保留不同起始位置。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 反應延遲被省略時，精確步速仍會產生偏低總時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Omitted response delay produces a low total despite precise walking speed. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：演練按時間戳辨認各階段，保留不同起始位置。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 偵知、通訊和供電構成串聯依賴，教材研究兩套感測器共用控制器時為何不能直接平方失效率。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Detection, communication and power form dependencies; examine why two sensors on one controller do not justify squaring failure probability. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.023 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000529 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00064009 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.023 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000529 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00064009 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 沿告警鏈逐點確認共用設備和故障傳遞。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 共同控制器失效會同時切斷兩個看似獨立感測通道。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~A common controller failure disables two apparently independent sensing channels. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：沿告警鏈逐點確認共用設備和故障傳遞。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.anchor: 剩餘集水容積~Remaining sump volume
units.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積~Outage buffer and effective sump volume
units.mechanism: 道路水、清洗水和滲水在假想集水系統中有不同時間尺度，教材分析同時進流對容量的影響。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。~Road water, wash water and seepage have different time scales; assess coincident inflows into a hypothetical sump. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
units.model: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=560 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=49.1228 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.6571 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=560 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=49.1228 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.6571 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將清洗計畫與降雨和泵曲線一起閉合水量帳。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Close the balance using cleaning schedules, rainfall and pump curves. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只依平日滲水選泵會漏掉清洗或事件排水尖峰。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。~Sizing from routine seepage alone misses wash or incident-drainage peaks. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.
units.misconception: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。~Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：將清洗計畫與降雨和泵曲線一起閉合水量帳。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Close the balance using cleaning schedules, rainfall and pump curves. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 蒙布朗整修窗口包含隔離、施工和重新測試，短期關閉的有效工時不能以日曆時間直接估算。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Refurbishment windows include isolation, work and retesting; productive hours differ from calendar closure duration. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=33 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=208.421 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為189.474 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=33 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=208.421 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 189.474 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 省略重測會留下設備已安裝但未證明可用的狀態。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Omitted retesting leaves installed equipment without demonstrated availability. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 跨境營運資料需讓事件時間、設備狀態與工單互相對應，蒙布朗教材要求保留事件版本而非覆寫。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Cross-border records must align event times, asset states and work orders while preserving revisions instead of overwriting history. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=113 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.4248 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=113 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.4248 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 時鐘不同步會顛倒事件順序而誤導根因分析。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Unsynchronised clocks reverse apparent event order and mislead root-cause analysis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「通風網路與壓力損失」，再獨立計算「疏散時間與分區可用性」。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.4775 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：前置時間=106 s；行走距離=300 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=481 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為518.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate ventilation network and pressure loss, then independently calculate evacuation time and zone availability. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.4775 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=106 s; travel distance=300 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=481 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 518.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1965 年公開記錄：蒙布朗跨境公路隧道於7月開通。蒙布朗隧道連接法國與義大利，營運機構列長11.6公里並記錄1965年開通。本課以長公路的系統思考為主軸，分別研究通風網路、受熱材料、事故偵知、人的反應、設備冗餘及整修交付。歷史事件只用核對過的年代，假想事故條件不被包裝為原事故重建。本課把「火災系統邊界、既有襯砌與跨境協作」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1965: Mont Blanc cross-border road tunnel opens to traffic in July. Mont Blanc Tunnel connects France and Italy; its operator reports 11.6 km and opening in 1965. This course uses a systems perspective on ventilation networks, heated materials, detection, human response, redundancy and refurbishment handover. Historical dates follow checked records, while hypothetical incident conditions are not presented as reconstruction of an actual accident. The course treats fire-system boundaries, existing lining and cross-border coordination as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 11.6 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 11.6 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.

教學「漫反射亮度」：照度=106 lx，其餘輸入依單元，結果=8.0978 cd/m²；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching diffuse luminance: illuminance=106 lx, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 8.0978 cd/m²; not measured or accepted project data.
